in_marathi.name: Ratnamala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Garland of Gems
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ratnamala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name that means 'Garland of Gems'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name that signifies wealth, prosperity, and beauty. This name is often given to girls in Hindu communities as a symbol of their value and worth.
